purpose: Paired identical-repeat-limit comparison in external delayed recovery and no-progress cases. Development only, no unused case claim.

intervention.observations: Real isolated HTTP frontend/backend, managed config and current diagnostic response. Unsupported tools return explicit errors. No root-host observations.
intervention.postcheck: Three independent HTTP samples across at least one second; effect monitor and protected-data evidence retained.

warmup: One fixed Hello message with max_tokens=8, recorded separately; not an incident trial
stopping: Exactly eight planned trials, no retry, replacement or outcome-based extension. Same model, generation, observations, tool surface, hints, and outer 300-second/8-turn bounds. Only identical-repeat limit differs within each mode. Preserve errors and missing rows.
gpu_measurement: Device-wide used MiB and compute processes sampled every 0.5 seconds. Preserve background workload; not isolated model VRAM or guaranteed instantaneous peak.
analysis: Report public HTTP observation completion before stopping, independent final HTTP window, controller status/times, guard stop, ordinary finish, outer timeout, setup errors, model/tool/approval wall spans, calls/tokens, Broker mutation/harm/boundary and missing evidence. Pair thresholds within mode and repetition; descriptive counts and paired elapsed differences only. Never call shorter failed execution faster recovery. Do not pool external recovery with autonomous repair.
input_nondeterminism: Record request/call IDs and full HTTP payloads rather than reusing security nonces. Temperature zero is not a claim of identical runtime state.
prior_cases: Four existing development cases only, none claimed unused. Main followup remains execution_allowed:false.
hardware_setting: 16 GPU layers selected before execution to leave room for the existing ~1398 MiB background workload on GTX1650 4GiB. Remaining layers use CPU. This is not full-offload fit evidence and is not directly comparable to LFM99-layer timings.
comparison: Relative to spark-http-dev-20260908, only HTTP observation version and monitor contract change. Prompt, model, generation, runtime, offload, deadlines, case order and approval support stay fixed. This jointly changes observation and measurement, not a single-mechanism causal estimate. Never rescore old results as v2.
system_prompt_suffix: Task-specific observation contract: An external recovery process may restore the dependency during this incident. Check HTTP health with service_status on host local for service nginx. While it is unhealthy, continue observing the same service_status until health is confirmed or a guard or time limit stops the task. Do not restart services or containers, change configuration, or invent a repair: this task is to observe externally managed recovery. When HTTP health is confirmed, finish with a short factual status.
scope: Known development HTTP dependency-down fixture. External recovery occurs after 120 seconds in delayed mode; never occurs in no-progress mode. Both modes have identical public inputs. Neither mode is autonomous model repair or unused evaluation.

provenance.selection: Prior thinking smoke reached typed calls and availability recovery; keep background GPU services running and use 16-layer offload. HTTP behavior is unproven.

checkpoint_policy: Save active trial before setup, before each model send and after response or error. Added checkpoint I/O is part of this development run timing; prior interrupted ablation remains unchanged.
ordering: Forward condition order in repetition 0, reverse in repetition 1; single model load and fixed warmup. Partial order balance only.
adoption: No production threshold change based on this development comparison. Multi-stage recovery and broader cases remain required to assess adoption.
